sap27-original-d1-01.alt: A consumer interface endpoint crosses PrivateLink to a provider Network Load Balancer for private HTTPS without peering overlapping VPCs. The provider approves the endpoint.

sap27-original-d2-01.alt: The calibration appliance uses the approved certificate and IAM Roles Anywhere to obtain temporary credentials. The role allows uploads only to the calibration S3 prefix.

sap27-original-d3-01.alt: A storage path compares demand against instance bandwidth, provisioned IOPS, and gp3 throughput. Increase the bottleneck throughput from 125 to 500 MiB per second without changing capacity or IOPS.

sap27-original-d4-01.alt: An online baseline transfer is followed by fencing writes, a final incremental sync, full file verification before switching clients to target-only writes.

sap27-original-d5-01.alt: Pipeline and authorized manual deployments both go through CloudFormation. A resource Hook validates RDS pre-create and pre-update, blocks failed checks, and is not a control for direct RDS API requests.
